info.name: FIT Tracker
info.summary: Activity tracker for running, cycling and gym workouts
info.description:
FIT Tracker is a Nextcloud app for tracking your fitness activities and sleep — powered by Garmin .fit files stored in your Nextcloud filesystem.
Simply point the app at a folder containing your exported .fit files and it will automatically import and parse them.
🏃 **Activity tracking** Recognizes the full Garmin FIT sport list — Running, Cycling, Hiking, Walking, Swimming, Gym, Breathwork, Meditation, Skiing, and dozens more (sailing, golf, rowing, kayaking, tennis, climbing, and others). Each activity shows distance, duration, average heart rate, and calories. The detail view includes an interactive map with GPS route, elevation profile, heart rate chart, a per-lap breakdown, and a Share button that generates a shareable image card. The dashboard shows a monthly activity calendar and a last-7-days bar chart, with sidebar navigation limited to the sport types you actually have data for.
😴 **Sleep tracking** Automatically detects Garmin sleep and nap files and separates them from activity files. View all sleep sessions with a monthly stacked bar chart (Deep / REM / Light / Awake), navigable month by month. Each sleep detail page shows total duration, sleep score, HRV score, a full sleep timeline with stage transitions, and a per-stage table.
📷 **Photo integration** For any activity with a GPS track, FIT Tracker automatically finds JPEG photos stored in your Nextcloud whose GPS coordinates fall within 200 m of the activity route. Photos appear as a thumbnail strip below the map and as clickable pins on the route map. Clicking a photo opens it in a full-screen overlay. Only GPS-tagged photos are shown.
⚙️ **Settings** Choose any folder in your Nextcloud as the source for .fit files. Re-sync is triggered automatically on folder save or manual navigation. A "Re-check sport types" button lets you reclassify already-imported activities under the current sport detection logic, including moving mis-imported sleep/nap files over to Sleep.
info.author: Ales Rosina
